body: Tried pinning every sibling require to v0.1.1 with versionless go.work replaces: Go refuses replaces of workspace modules, and without them it fetches the untagged v0.1.1 go.mod even in workspace mode. Chosen: keep v0.0.0-00010101000000-000000000000 plus versioned replaces for development; the release plan pins each module's requires to the real tag right after that dependency is tagged, then go mod tidy outside the workspace (GOWORK=off) proves it.
title: Requires stay at the zero version until each sibling is tagged
